external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provide daily extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: The source names three partners but does not distinguish them individually.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that lists and reads files from the landing bucket and triggers Spark transform jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in. Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily partner extract files.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted". It also says the bucket is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest." It also says both the landing bucket and this database are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse destination into which normalized claim records are loaded.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes a daily extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.notes: Each partner has a static key issued at onboarding; the keys have not changed since.
data_flows.data_description: Daily extract containing claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists the landing bucket and reads the files present there.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
data_flows.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: trigger job
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized claim records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.description: An analyst queries the warehouse directly.
data_flows.notes: Analysts are on the warehouse network and authenticate with SSO. The grant is dataset-wide; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Airflow scheduler runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the Spark transform job runs and analysts are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
trust_boundaries.notes: The source also says analysts are on the warehouse network.
